Read more Flexible sealing solutions for cables and pipes Roxtec develops, manufactures and delivers flexible sealing solutions for cable and pipe penetrations . Roxtec modular-based transits are used for cable sealing and pipe sealing in numerous demanding industries and projects worldwide as the seals provide certified protection against multiple risks, including fire , gas and water. The Roxtec invention for adaptability, Multidiameter™ , is based on sealing modules with removable rubber layers and allows for a perfect sealing, regardless of the outside dimension of the cable or pipe. Explore our sealing solutions on roxtec.com The Roxtec website presents the global Roxtec Group, which serves and supports cable and pipe seal users in more than 80 markets, and the wide range of industries that benefit from using Roxtec safety seals in walls, floors, decks, bulkheads and cabinet and enclosure applications . You find complete product data for the various Roxtec sealing solutions and sealing components as well as extensive information that will help you understand the difference between Roxtec MCT (multi-cable transit) sealing technology and cable glands . How to solve sealing problems by using Roxtec transits At roxtec.com, we want to serve our customers and partners, and at the same time make it possible for new acquaintances to gain knowledge about Roxtec. Under the section The Roxtec way, you can explore what makes the Roxtec offer unique and how we continue to develop for safety, for example through a software suite and tests and certifications. If this is your first visit, you can start by finding your industry and discover the many application areas for Roxtec seals. We continuously publish in-depth articles to help you solve problems by using our innovative sealing solutions, such as seals for electromagnetic shielding or non-weld seals that enable you to eliminate the welding process . Current subjects include how to protect your metal pipe penetrations and how to seal underground conduit . Product news Published: 7 October 2026 Operations in harsh environments – such as offshore splash zones, high-chloride areas, and aggressive chemical processing – require reliable seals with a long service life. We have frequently helped customers with customized sleeves, seals and fittings in stainless steel quality like Super Duplex for these extreme conditions. From now on, you can find components for rectangular sealing solutions, such as the Roxtec Wedge 120 and the Roxtec Stayplate 120 , in super stainless steel in our standard product portfolio. You can find them displayed under their respective product sections on roxtec.com. “When lifetime performance, safety, and durability matter, duplex steel delivers the strength and corrosion protection required for critical offshore HVDC infrastructure,” says Matthias Brück, Global Segment Manager Wind Power at Roxtec. Building on our established duplex and super duplex transit frames, the addition of wedges and stayplates in super stainless steel enables a complete Roxtec sealing solution in super stainless steel, designed to optimize performance and service life in extreme environments. Corrosion class CX Note that we can supply all our stainless-steel frames in super stainless steel. Super stainless steel, such as 254 SMO (EN 1.4547 / UNS S31254) and 2507 Super Duplex (EN 1.4410 / UNS S32750), has typically the corrosion class CX and can significantly reduce maintenance costs and the risk of corrosion-related failures in demanding applications. “On an offshore oil and gas asset, corrosion is not only a maintenance issue. It is an asset integrity issue. Super Duplex gives the durability and corrosion resistance needed to protect critical barriers and secure reliable performance throughout the asset lifecycle,” says Morten Gustavsen, Global Segment Manager Marine & Offshore at Roxtec. Business news Published: 28 April 2026 LNG, liquefied natural gas, is an important part of the global energy transition. Processing LNG, however, requires rigorous safety measures and tested, approved, and certified protection systems. A perfect example is the Roxtec sealing system for cable and pipe entries, which comes with certified protection for engineered certainty and support from experienced experts. Roxtec sealing solutions provide multi-hazard protection. They contribute to safe and continuous operations by preventing fire, gas, water, and EMI as well as the risk of ignition of flammable gas. This has been proven for decades in LNG projects around the world. “We have been a global sealing partner within oil and gas for more than 30 years and have a proven record of success”, says Leo Konradsson, Global Segment Manager Power & Process industries. “We have also tested our products to the absolute limit in jet fire and gas cloud explosion tests. The thing is that you cover all requirements with one solution.” “We have tested our products to the absolute limit." Leo Konradsson, Global Segment Manager Power & Process industries, Roxtec Support from early design to future expansion Being a partner means more than providing a product. Roxtec sealing experts work together with operators, design engineers, and installers to provide support – from front-end engineering design to construction, retrofit and expansion. With global coverage and assistance from the headquarters in Sweden, Roxtec enables smooth collaboration in large LNG projects that involve several countries or regions. “By being present, we learn about the challenges our customers must overcome,” says Adam Hall, Sales Manager Process industries. “It is important to simplify the process. Our free transit design software, for example, enables customers to save time and keep the schedule on track, and time is money. Also, our adaptable seals make it so much easier to handle late-stage changes and upgrades. Changes happen all the time. I believe flexibility is the reason why we are chosen for so many LNG projects in the US.” Trusted technical advisor in decarbonization projects In addition to this specific industry knowledge, there is the Roxtec commitment to support all kinds of decarbonization projects – from sustainable aviation fuels and e-fuels to hydrogen and carbon capture. This work has also developed Roxtec into a trusted technical advisor: many projects need to standardize with solutions providing multi-hazard protection, space savings in high cable density areas and modular flexibility. “Roxtec products are ideal for LNG projects.” Adam Hall, Sales Manager Process industries, Roxtec Learn more about sealing in high-risk environments Roxtec sealing experts enjoy sharing their insights. You can listen to two of them, Chris Hipple and Mike Gawlikowski, in a recorded webinar available on roxtec.com. They have been working with cutting-edge LNG projects along the US Gulf Coast for years and know about everything from increasing safety requirements to efficient protection of sensitive electronic equipment, which is crucial as the LNG industry is becoming more electrified, digitalized and automized. In addition to protection from the hazards mentioned, Roxtec seals also protect against other factors, such as vibration, water, and rodents, meaning that your electrical assets can stay up and operational through many different situations. Do you want to learn more about the importance of specifying and installing the right safety components in LNG facilities? Watch the recorded Roxtec webinar “Engineering certainty in LNG projects: Sealing solutions for high-consequence environments”. Note: the image of the LNG facility above is AI generated.
